# Text glyphs for Yu-Gi-Oh! The Sacred C: # A text record holds the two-byte escape 0x87 <code> for one accented letter; this table maps
# <code> to the letter it renders. Verified by reading the byte pairs inside known words of the
# 900 card names (evidence per row is in docs/game-data.md); nothing here is guessed from a formula.
#   verified    = read from two or more different words in the ROM
#   single-read = read from exactly one word
#   unknown     = code seen in the ROM
# Lines starting with # and blank lines are ignored. Bytes are UTF-8.
